mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_contract_file ( domain_type, reference_id, original_filename, saved_filename, file_size, file_type, created_at ) VALUES ( #{domainType}, #{referenceId}, #{originalFilename}, #{savedFilename}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT file_id AS fileId, domain_type AS domainType, reference_id AS referenceId, original_filename AS originalFilename, saved_filename AS savedFilename, file_size AS fileSize, file_type AS fileType, created_at AS createdAt FROM loan_contract_file WHERE domain_type = #{domainType} AND reference_id = #{referenceId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT f.file_id AS fileId, f.domain_type AS domainType, f.reference_id AS referenceId, f.original_filename AS originalFilename, f.saved_filename AS savedFilename, f.file_size AS fileSize, f.file_type AS fileType, f.created_at AS createdAt FROM loan_contract_file f JOIN loan_contract c ON c.contract_id = f.reference_id WHERE c.creditor_id = #{userId} OR c.debtor_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT file_id AS fileId, domain_type AS domainType, reference_id AS referenceId, original_filename AS originalFilename, saved_filename AS savedFilename, file_size AS fileSize, file_type AS fileType, created_at AS createdAt FROM loan_contract_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
